language.artifactBoundary: OperationalProgram is the only independently serialized/versioned IR artifact; nested AST values are not standalone artifacts.
language.conversationRule: CONVERSATION is not operational computation and validation rejects it as NOT_APPLICABLE.
language.tenantRule: No IR field supplies tenant ownership. Entity and open JSON keys shaped like tenant selectors are rejected; lowering accepts tenant identity only through TrustedLoweringContext.
language.hardConstraintRule: A known HARD violation is an error and rejects the program; a known SOFT violation is retained as a warning.
language.verificationRule: Observation.verificationFloor is the literal EXISTING_OR_STRONGER; Effect expected observations must be REQUIRED.

semanticBoundaries: Operational IR Effect is planning intent, not BusinessEffectSet
BusinessEffectSet remains the immutable consequential execution contract
Provider Operation remains an existing provider-bound runtime identity
Execution Receipt remains existing observed execution truth
Work and Objective remain durable lifecycle truth
Observation and reconciliation remain execution truth

canonicalSerialization.format: deterministic RFC-8785-style JSON over the strict IR JSON domain

shadow.candidatePolicy: Use the exact InstructionRouteDecision and OperationalQueryInterpretation already produced by existing deterministic routing.
pipeline: execute only the existing authoritative query path
shadow.recording: Structured log summary only; request bodies/selectors, tenant identity, and full IR are not logged.
shadow.failurePolicy: All construction, validation, lowering, comparison, and recorder failures are contained and cannot change the authoritative path.

productionShadow: QUERY: lossless same-candidate OperationalQueryRequest round trip
pureCompatibility: ATOMIC_EFFECT and KNOWN_ACTION_COMPATIBILITY to DomainAction plan: LOSSY and conditional on explicit same-candidate desired state, observations, audited compiledGraph, and trusted runtime identities
one Objective query/action/wait decision: LOSSY and conditional on explicit missing semantics

unsupportedLegacySeams: No HumanOperation symbol exists at the audited baseline.
InstructionRouteDecision alone lacks desired-state computation except its separately adapted query request.
DomainAction alone lacks Goal, intended-state, observation, and success semantics.
Existing atomic planner output does not yet emit explicit desired-state predicates required for production IR shadowing.
Objective complete/block/fail remain controller truth and are NOT_APPLICABLE as executable IR nodes.
Static multi-step Branch/Wait/Compensation programs cannot lower into the current one-decision Objective controller.
BusinessEffectSet is comparison-only downstream truth and never converts back into executable IR.
p2Deferrals: DB-aware resolution and validation of unresolved or ambiguous EntityRef values inside trusted TenantContext.
Runtime capability, authority, BusinessEffect typing, cost, risk, and legality checks beyond structural/static IR validity.
An enriched planning/compiler candidate that supplies explicit desired-state and verification semantics for production ATOMIC_EFFECT and OBJECTIVE shadow coverage.
Scoped authoritative cutover policy and persisted rollout telemetry after deterministic shadow gates remain green.
laterThanP2Deferrals: P4 solver-backed program search, optimization, and e-graphs.
Any replacement of Authority, BusinessEffect, Work, Objective, Context, Memory, Computer runtime, CausalReplay, or canonical business truth.
